comment: The plain files that a release of another polyspec repository publishes as assets and that this repository reads, pinned by the release tag and the sha256 of each file (HR-80, docs/operations/dependencies.md). The files object of an entry is the files object of the asset files.json of that release, copied as it is. The tag equals the tag of the Cargo dependency line of the library in packages/rust/Cargo.toml. make hyper-install-release-files installs each file into var/release-files/<library>/<tag>/<path>.
